packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
UNVERIFIED IMAGE READING (packet-03). Images only; no outside source consulted; no identification of work or author attempted.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- 13 images. image-001 = overview of side A; image-002..009 = detail pieces of side A; image-010 = overview of side B; image-011..013 = detail pieces of side B.
- Object: a parchment strip/fragment, upright, attached at a gutter to a later paper leaf (the paper leaf carries later cursive ink notes, unrelated script, not read here). A ruler in the overview shows the fragment is roughly 10 cm wide on side A, about 7 cm on side B.
- Side A shows TWO columns. The right column is nearly complete in width but cropped/trimmed at the right edge (line ends lost by a letter or two) and has heavy surface loss in its upper third. The left column is torn, creased, perforated and partly folded over; only its lower half is usefully legible. The column sequence (which column precedes) cannot be told from the image alone.
- Side B shows ONE narrow column (the back of one of the side-A columns), top third destroyed by holes, lower two thirds clear.
- Headings: red running title at the top of side A, split over the two columns: left "[..]ppel" (?), right "III" (red strokes, possibly a numeral or the end of the word). Side B has a red heading "Appell(?)a" (reads "appll'a" with abbreviation stroke) at the top.
- Red paragraph marks and red-touched initials at the left of the columns; red bracket lines run down the left margin of both columns joining groups of lines. One larger red-and-black initial "C" in the right column of side A (image-007 line 14 / image-009 line 2). No enlarged decorated initials otherwise.
- No interlinear gloss in the main hand; one faint later pencil/ink note between lines in image-007 (between lines 10 and 11), illegible. Double vertical strokes "||" occur inside lines as text dividers (image-005, image-007, image-013).
- Script: small, heavily abbreviated Gothic book hand, brown-black ink.
- Tentative interpretation only: continuous prose in short paragraphs with frequent abbreviated references (forms like "ex.", "e.", "C.", "ff.", "in tex. et in glo.") - i.e. reference-bearing prose, not a main text surrounded by commentary.

AREAS SELECTED
(1) Side A right column, middle and lower part (image-005, 007, 009) - best preserved connected prose.
(2) Side B column, lower two thirds (image-012, 013) - clear.
(3) Side A left column, lower part (image-006, 008) - partial, creased.
UNREAD / LARGELY UNREAD: side A both columns' upper thirds (image-002, 003, 004: only isolated words); side B upper third (image-011: isolated words). Line numbers are counted from the top of each image and are approximate where the top line is cut by the crop.

Conventions: (..) proposed expansion; ? after an uncertain reading; [illegible]; [...] loss; | end not visible (trimmed edge).
